transcript.text: I need to flag a critical technical finding before we proceed. My completed radio-frequency survey found that wireless roaming camera links interfere with the Orpheum Theater's assistive-listening loop. Because of that, the gala must use three fixed wired cameras operating from the marked camera platforms — no wireless roaming cameras. I filed the survey in the technical folder, but I want to make sure it's reflected on Mara's draft lock sheet before final approval, since the current draft package references three cameras but doesn't specify this constraint.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical rights issue before we proceed. The signed performance license I received this morning — the countersigned copy — permits the gala broadcast but explicitly prohibits any video-on-demand release and prohibits later promotional clips. The recording must be marked broadcast-only. I have not yet entered this restriction in the rights tracker, so the current draft package's reference to reusing the recording in the festival archive would violate the license. We need to remove the festival archive reuse from the package before final approval, and the recording must be designated broadcast-only.

transcript.text: I need to flag two critical talent constraints before we proceed. First, I confirmed with the headliner's agent that the performer can soundcheck only at exactly 3:00 PM on Saturday — this is not yet reflected in the production schedule. Second, the headliner's rider explicitly prohibits sponsor product placement anywhere on the performance stage. I have the agent's confirmation in email. This directly conflicts with the current draft package, which includes a sponsor product display on stage. That sponsor display must be removed from the stage area before final approval.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical accessibility requirement before we proceed. My accessibility vendor confirmed that the live caption feed requires the captioner to work from Booth B, whose dedicated return feed is connected to the gala's caption encoder. The general plan's control-room location will not work for the caption feed. I documented the vendor confirmation in the accessibility file, but I have not yet added the booth assignment to the lock sheet. This booth assignment needs to be reflected on the lock sheet before final approval.
